card.name: Decibel units inside dB and decibel
card.fires_on: The later pieces of the word "decibel" (dec-ibel, decib-els) and the "dB" or "dBm" unit written right after a number, in sound or signal-strength statements.

modes.label: Inside "decibel"
modes.description: Middle or final pieces of the word decibel after a noise level number.
modes.example: wearing headphones playing Nirvana at 300 decib<<els>>. That done I headed for Seattle.

modes.label: dB after a number
modes.description: The B or dB part of the unit directly after a figure in gain or power specs.
modes.example: the low-noise amplifier provides 27-d<<B>> gain with 1.3-dB
